schema-validator.description: Validates JSON schemas, generates Pydantic models, ensures type safety across the Fiction-Factory pipeline's 25 schemas

fiction-plan.template:
Review the Fiction-Factory architecture and help plan: $ARGUMENTS

Reference the current implementation phase in IMPLEMENTATION_PLAN.md and ensure your recommendations align with the standing decisions in DECISIONS.md.

validate-schemas.template:
Run schema validation across all schemas in schemas/ directory:
1. Validate JSON schema syntax
2. Generate Pydantic models with datamodel-code-generator
3. Test schemas against sample data in tests/
4. Check for sentinel strings (TBD, TODO, etc.)
5. Verify Universal Core + Genre Module compatibility
6. Report any validation failures

Run: make validate-schemas
validate-schemas.description: Run validation across all 25 Fiction-Factory schemas

check-bible.template:
Review the Fiction-Factory bible and continuity system:
1. Check BibleSteward propose/validate/commit deltas
2. Verify LoopTracker promise deadline enforcement
3. Validate ContinuityLedger entries
4. Report any inconsistencies or missing entries
check-bible.description: Verify Fiction-Factory bible and continuity consistency
